scope: Extant Palm Tree Mosque at 185 Long Street, with Cape Georgian frontage, lowered threshold and mapped rear ranges.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The exhibit labels the exact 1915 Cape Archives image by Elliott public domain and identifies the date palm currently at the site.
The architectural register confirms the extant two-storey converted house, Cape Georgian vernacular and the public-domain Western Cape Archives photograph by Elliott.
Raising Long Street shortened the door and lowered the apparent ground-floor window heights relative to the sidewalk.
The guide records one surviving date palm and the current street address, 185 Long Street.
